rules.script_unit: each role script is one complete move ending in `done` ($FF $FF); one `end` ($FF xx) is one fight frame (tick)
rules.hurt_flag: idle / walk / strike scripts need >= 1 draw with the hurt flag (a defender is hit where a hurt-flagged frame has pixels)
rules.attack_flag: an attack role needs >= 1 draw with the attack flag whose frame has an attack point in the creature's hit set (a cel without a hit set never hits)

die.meaning: the creature only dies through its scripts: every hurt role must contain `ifdead` jumping to a die sequence; the die sequence must call `engine LAB_0005` (fightCreatureDied: counts the wave down, spawns the next creature or ends the fight) exactly once and end with `kill` ($BC) before `done`.  $B4 resets the work block when it jumps.

rules.second_script: `second` ($AC) arms a second script that runs before the job each frame (y forced to 0): used for shadows / trails
rules.flag_events: the 8 AIs own their flag bytes (+104 / +105): none of the original scripts contains a poke ($A8); a poke stores the LOW BYTE of its long (MOVE.B), it does not OR a bit
rules.gore: $98 `ifnogore` jumps when LAB_06DA is non-zero (menu Gore: Off / demo); draws flagged nogore ($80) are skipped then

sound_banks.rule: sound id = synth sequence index (rt::sfxRequest); ids needing only wave/C7/C9 play in every fight; C8 ids need the creature file that holds their samples; CB ids need Ra.a

limits.second_area: slot area at LAB_05B9[11] = b9_44 = LAB_05C2: the 50,000-byte (0xC350) spare screen buffer; Mudmen loads Mudmen2 there, Balok / dragon / troll put kn5.ob there (32,000 bytes estimate), Demon its picture; a creature that also needs kn5 has 50,000 - 32,000 bytes left
limits.hit_pair_table: LAB_0A51: 84 bytes = 10 pairs of {cel table, hit set} + one spare long; the asm scans by a compare with NO terminator (an unregistered cel runs off the table), the C++ counts the pairs (rt/creatures.cpp:75); registering an 11th pair overwrites LAB_0A52 and what follows (rtHitLoad_mog has no bound)
limits.attack_point_note: x / y are 3 decimal digits stored as BYTES (hitParse): at most 255, wrap above; the gate box (maxDx, maxDy) is the byte of the largest x / y of the frame

frame_size.rule: w <= 336 (21 words: the view is 320 px, planCel clips only one side of a frame that crosses the left edge) and (2 * ceil(w / 16) + 2) * rows <= 4800 per temp plane (clipped rows count); anything larger overruns into the next temp plane

limits.cel_header: byte8 = 1 in every original file (runtime flips bit 0 / the high nibble when mirrored); byte9 = plane bits
limits.palette_note: indices 6..8 belong to the first fighter; 9..14 creature colours (scene code), 15 blood red
